active_set_policy: Read exactly the current 64 active IDs from config/brand64-active-brands.json. INACTIVE_LEGACY_REFERENCE brands are preserved separately and never included in active aggregation.
comparison_policy: Compare 2026-08-23 against the latest saved 2026-08-21 base plus intraday overlay. Do not fabricate 2026-08-22 observations and do not equate a missing observation with no change. Do not claim no-change where current product-level freshness is insufficient.
offline_policy: Never delete known products when an official page becomes unavailable. Preserve the last confirmed fields and mark SOURCE_OFFLINE with last confirmed date.
conflict_policy: Do not overwrite fresher baselines with stale/conflicting badges, search indexes, or older crawls. Record SOURCE_STATE_CONFLICT and recheck the live product page.
dedupe_policy: Deduplicate by official product URL and product code when available; never duplicate the same URL/code.
